annotations.title: Attach planned scenes to an overlay pack

description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. Consumes a plan from plan_overlay_pack, spending its quoted credits and ATTACHING those scenes to the existing design-approved project (it never creates a new project -- that happened at create_design_sheet time). Calling this again with the same planId after it already succeeded is safe -- it returns the same project rather than attaching the scenes a second time or charging twice. Returns immediately, before any scene has rendered -- call get_pack_status afterward to advance and check progress.
name: create_overlay_pack
